# Release Notes

## Features
- [#131] Filter audit logs by date range, user ID, and action category.

## Fixes
- [#132] Fixed pagination controls resetting to page 1 unexpectedly on customer orders page.

## Breaking Changes
- [#133] Removed deprecated v1 REST API endpoints; all applications must migrate to v2 OAuth endpoints.
